_comment: Monorepo root for a new multi-project system (agent workspace layer). Text tokens are replaced verbatim; __APPS_TABLE__, __SDKS_TABLE__ and __PROJECTS_JSON__ are filled by the engine from the chosen projects; the __BUSINESS_*__ / language / currency / time-zone tokens come from the business-domain answers (TBD when skipped). Binary files under .claude/skills are copied as-is.

placeholder_notes.__SYSTEM_NAME_AR__: Arabic name of the system (used in the business paragraph and localization notes).
placeholder_notes.__SYSTEM_SLUG__: Lower-case slug used in package/folder names (e.g. `acme`).
placeholder_notes.__SYSTEM_PREFIX__: Short upper-case prefix for repo-level task ids (e.g. `T`).
placeholder_notes.__ADMIN_DIR__: Folder of the admin web panel (e.g. `Acme-Admin-Dashboard`).
placeholder_notes.__APPS_TABLE__: Engine-filled markdown rows `| Path | Project | Status |` for every app (mobile/web) project.
placeholder_notes.__SDKS_TABLE__: Engine-filled markdown rows `| Path | Project | Status |` for every SDK/package.
placeholder_notes.__PROJECTS_JSON__: Engine-filled JSON object: the `projects` map of .claude/projects.json (key -> {title, prefix, dir, master, backlog, session, memory, integration}).
placeholder_notes.__RULES_JSON__: Engine-filled JSON object: the `rules` map of .claude/projects.json (rule id -> true/false) the generated hooks read; ids come from catalog/rules.json, false = turned off in the plan.
placeholder_notes.__MASTERS_LIST__: Comma-separated list of master branch names in backticks (e.g. `server`, `admin`, `app`).
placeholder_notes.__OWNER_GITHUB__: GitHub user/org that owns the repository.
placeholder_notes.__BUSINESS_SUMMARY__: Owner's business summary (~10 lines, multi-line, on its own line).
placeholder_notes.__RTL__: `on` when the default layout is right-to-left, else `off`.
placeholder_notes.__CURRENCY_MINOR_UNIT__: Minor unit and decimals of the currency (or TBD).
placeholder_notes.__STORED_TIME_ZONE__: Time zone timestamps are stored in (default UTC).
placeholder_notes.__BUSINESS_TIME_ZONE__: IANA time zone business dates/hours are computed in (or TBD).
placeholder_notes.__BUSINESS_ACTORS__: Markdown bullets: actors/roles and their permissions (multi-line, own line).
placeholder_notes.__BUSINESS_RULES__: Numbered markdown lines: the core business rules (multi-line, own line).
placeholder_notes.__BUSINESS_ENTITIES__: Markdown bullets: entities and their states/transitions (multi-line, own line).
placeholder_notes.__BUSINESS_JOBS__: Markdown bullets: scheduled jobs and reminders (multi-line, own line).
placeholder_notes.__BUSINESS_INTEGRATIONS__: Markdown bullets: integrations (OTP, payments, push, storage, maps, analytics) or `decide later`.
placeholder_notes.__OPEN_DECISIONS__: Markdown bullets: owner decisions still open, including every answer left TBD (multi-line, own line).
